primary: complete full paired six-domain50 results for each method and backbone; no partial/seed selection
contrast: author versus shared with same stable supervised loss, unchanged source KD/modes, independent data RNG reset; method-specific preprocessing maintained
shared_deficit_gate: shared final mean at least .05 below paired author mean, no numerical or completeness failures
gradient_gate: shared median weightedKD/supervised norm ratio < .05 AND < 0.5 * author ratio; both measured on preregistered steps
if_both_pass: candidate lambda=.001 * author_median/shared_median, clipped to [.001,.01]; one fixed value per method from train gradients, not a validation grid; freeze before fresh paired six-domain50 validation
if_zero_kd: do not divide by zero or calibrate blindly; inspect stored transition checkpoints for numerical/teacher faults
otherwise: inspect stage-matrix forgetting and retained teacher checkpoints for a specific mechanism; do not claim small loss as healthy KD or launch arbitrary grid
user_scope_update: author-identical protocol no longer required; goal reliable current benchmark adaptation; source net is diagnostic only
